beginner

Champ Select Basics: Bans, Picks and Roles

How champion select works in ranked, what to ban, when to pick safe champions, and what to do when things go wrong before the game even starts.

intermediate

Reading the Enemy Team: Pick and Build Against It

Spot what the enemy team wants to do, then choose a champion and items that shut it down: armor or magic resist, anti-heal, tank shredding, and answers to dive, poke and crowd control.

intermediate

Team Synergy: Building a Comp That Works

Five strong champions don't always make a strong team. Learn to balance damage types, frontline, engage, peel and wave clear, and how the main team composition types win.

advanced

Counter-Picking: When and How to Pick Into Someone

Counter picks win lanes when they're used well and lose games when they're not. Learn what makes a counter, when comfort beats it, and how to use a last pick for the whole team.
